english.note: Use this when beyond means in addition to or apart from A.
Use this when “beside” means in addition to A.

examples.english: Beyond the rent, we also have to pay a management fee.
examples.traditional: 除咗租金之外，仲要畀管理費。

examples.english: Beside inviting Ming, I also invited Cheung.
examples.traditional: 除咗阿明之外，我仲邀請咗阿強。
examples.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 aa3 ming4 zi1 ngoi6 ngo5 zung6 jiu1 cing2 zo2 aa3 koeng4
